Operator commands:
  daemon         Manage the persistent controller
  update         Update to the newest attested green main build in one command (CAD-561): check →...
  backup         Back up the store with SQLite's online backup API
  restore        Restore a backup (its `.manifest.json`) or an export bundle (its directory) into the...
  export         Write a portable bundle (`cadence.sqlite3` + `manifest.json`) to a new directory
  ui             The read-only board UI + JSON API on loopback
  master         The master agent (CAD-339): one per install, alias `master` — the operator's assistant...
  connection     Connected platforms (CAD-366, ADR 0006 §5.3): credential custody and per-agent grants
  platform       Platform accounts (ADR 0006): the operator enrolls, rotates and revokes scoped...
  app            Apps (CAD-547): an installable folder — `app.md` + `workflows/` + optional `rubrics/`,...
  audit          Reconstruct every merge on the default branch from stored data — verdict notes, commit...
  review         Review a PR end-to-end: detached checkout under `.cadence/wt/review-<pr>` (the merge...
  sandbox        A disposable Cadence beside production: its own state dir, tracker and board port...
  session        Session bookends — `start` runs the morning go/no-go gate (host, binary, daemon,...
  staging        CAD-1024: the staging-delegation allowlist and grant store (operator-only...
  org            Select an organization/connection preference (CAD-1019)

Advanced commands:
  agent-uid      ADR 0007 T1: the dedicated-agent-uid lane — provision the boundary once (explicitly,...
  attach         Attach this terminal to a live agent's native endpoint
  auth           Inspect or remove local AgenticOS credentials
  claude         Launch a Claude agent on a managed stream-json endpoint — one long-lived headless...
  codex          Launch a Codex agent on a managed-ws endpoint, attachable by the official Codex TUI...
  cursor         Launch a Cursor Agent terminal (`cursor-agent`) as a managed agent on the pty endpoint...
  delivery       The worker loop (CAD-431): a ticket the master dispatched goes to its worker; the...
  devin          Launch a Devin agent
  events         Read the durable event log for an agent
  idea           Plans (CAD-359/360): a proposed epic with its tickets
  intake         Relay local report issues to explicitly configured GitHub projects and poll actionable...
  interrupt      Stop an agent's running turn with the provider's own interrupt — Claude's stream-json...
  job            Jobs: the work axis
  login          Authenticate to an AgenticOS issuer
  message        Send durable messages to an agent
  milestone      Milestones (CAD-405): declared in the project's PROJECT.md or named by an issue's...
  monitor        Daemon-owned persistent supervision registrations and local alerts
  overview       What needs a human right now: merge-ready PRs, open approvals, fenced or stalled...
  project        Projects (CAD-358): `new` registers a repo and seeds its PROJECT.md
  remote         Retain, inspect or explicitly send a local result to hosted queued custody
  report         File a report: a question, feedback, idea or bug becomes a tracker issue with context...
  resume         Resume a group: the PM first, then every member whose `params.upstream` names it and...
  rollout        One durable rollout claim
  setup          First run, idempotent: create what is missing — state dir, tracker, skill, daemon,...
  skill          Install or inspect the `cadence` agent skill under `~/.agents/skills/cadence` with...
  stop           Stop a whole group — the PM and every member
  test           Queue a cargo test on the daemon (CAD-129)
  thread         An agent's durable conversation thread (CAD-319): the operator's chat with it,...
  upgrade        Install the exact build CI tested on main (CAD-334)
  workflow       Workflows (CAD-487): reusable plan files with `inputs:`, stored as...

Details for one verb: cadence help <verb>
Every command path: cadence help all
